description: Source code implementing FIS table updating functions for MTD, including functions for opening, validating, and remapping FIS partitions.

methods.name: fis_close
methods.description: Closes the FIS descriptor and unmaps memory.

methods.name: fis_open
methods.description: Opens the FIS directory, maps it into memory, and returns the descriptor.

methods.name: fis_validate
methods.description: Validates the FIS partitions against old and new partition lists.

methods.name: fis_remap
methods.description: Remaps the FIS table with new partition information.
